caption: The drawing shows two objects: a cup and a saucer, both depicted with delicate purple, lilac, and pink hues and floral decorations. The cup is illustrated in a slightly elevated side view, revealing a flared rim and gently tapering base. Its exterior surface features a central flower motif with orange petals, a yellow outline, and a blue center bordered by green, flanked by purple wavy lines. The interior of the cup is mostly white with a thin, brownish rim. Below the cup is a top-down view of the saucer, which is round with concentric circles at the center. The saucer’s surface is decorated with an elaborate pattern of curving purple, lilac, and pink fields, interspersed with green and brown lines resembling foliage, as well as small red, white, and yellow stylized flowers and plants. The drawing is framed with a simple rectangular line, and the words “ACTUAL SIZE” and the name “A. Camilli” appear written at the bottom. The background is plain off-white paper.
title: Cup and Saucer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
